_doc: Proof gates. Two independent axes decide what a proof shows. DESIGN STAGE (0-10, computed from the built font by sinhala_coverage.py against stages.json) decides WHICH sections appear: a section is shown once the font has reached its min_stage, so a stage-3 font is never judged against conjunct or long-mark text it cannot yet set. DEVELOPMENT STAGE (the build channel: canary / dev / release) decides HOW DEEP the proof goes: see 'channels'. Section slugs are the file stems in sections/ -- the vendored corpus is never edited to add gating; this file is the only place a section's stage lives.

stage_blocks._doc: Sections whose body is itself split into '## Stage N' blocks. Only blocks with N <= the font's stage are shown, so the stage-keyed corpus tracks the font as it matures.

channels._doc: Development stage -> proof depth. gated: false shows every section regardless of design stage (a release claims completeness, so holes should show). pdf: also render a PDF book (needs Playwright/Chromium).
